final_schedule.frame_qualification: Review the recorded paired comparisons without adding a tolerance; memory/GC guards alone do not qualify a candidate.

cover-freeze-1.status: failed; not a completed wake measurement
cover-freeze-1.cause: Unknown. Game exit 137 and heartbeat catch-up/reconnect warnings accompany thaw. The subsequent input pipe broke; do not classify this as the earlier FIFO ENXIO race or as a successful wake.
cover-freeze-1.next: Repeat unchanged as cover-freeze-2; keep this failed experiment and exclude it from valid-run averages.

ferrite-1-input-race.status: invalid wake window; rerun entire pair
ferrite-1-input-race.cause: Wake sender reopened a nonblocking FIFO writer for each command; vinput.py briefly closes/reopens its reader at EOF. ENXIO occurred during a transient reader gap.
ferrite-1-input-race.fix: Retain one writer for the wake window; retry ENXIO at startup for at most one second; dead-reader timeout assertion remains two seconds.
ferrite-1-input-race.data: Partial trial and its preceding valid control retained here. Neither counts toward the two completed pairs.

nether-control-interrupted.status: interrupted at return; no complete wake window
nether-control-interrupted.cause: Unknown sender of SIGTERM; controller disappeared and private compositor/X connection ended. This is not attributed to GC, OOM, the allocator or an owner action.
nether-control-interrupted.repetition: Repeat the entire baseline once, unchanged, from the same fresh saved base; retain this partial record outside final means. No parameter or assertion changed.
